beats.summary: Erin and Andy rehearse a news anchor audition scene with Clark directing.

beats.summary: Andy feels unsatisfied with the take and wants to do more, but Clark insists they are done.

evidence.snippet: Andy: I don't think we did get it. I could do, uh, a couple more takes.

beats.summary: Andy asks Pete to take Erin out for food after the audition.

evidence.snippet: Erin: Hey, even if this doesn't work out for me, I'm just glad I had the guts to do it.
